headline: Fix your data without the risk.
lead: DataFixer finds what is wrong in your data files, shows you every change before it happens, and lets you undo it afterwards.
promises: Preview every change before it is made.
Undo it afterwards, if you change your mind.
Nothing is merged unless you say so.
formats: Bring the files you already have: CSV, Excel, JSON or XML.
founder: I ran a CRM company for years and watched people struggle with dirty data. This is the tool I wished they had.

items.title: Preview and undo
items.text: See every change before it happens, and undo it afterwards if you change your mind.

items.title: Clean and match in one place
items.text: Fix problems such as badly formatted telephone numbers and postcodes, then find duplicates, with rules you can see.

items.title: You decide
items.text: Review each possible match, confirm or reject it, and filter the list to find what matters.

items.title: A record of every change
items.text: See who did what, and when, in an activity log your team can check.

coming_soon: Coming soon: one-click flows that clean, de-duplicate and export on their own; reports with charts; and an API.

privacy_aside.title: Privacy assured.
privacy_aside.text: Every change is logged and visible to you.
